title: Elucidating the Membrane Binding Process of a Disordered Protein: Dynamic Interplay of Anionic Lipids and the Polybasic Region
authors: Azadeh Alavizargar; Maximilian Gass; Michael P. Krahn; Andreas Heuer
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究无序蛋白LKB1多碱性区与阴离子脂质膜的动态结合，属蛋白-膜互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象偏离课题核心。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered regions of proteins are responsible for many biological processes such as in the case of liver kinase LKB1 – a serine/threonine kinase, relevant for cell proliferation and cell polarity. LKB1 itself becomes fully activated upon recruitment to the plasma membrane by binding of its disordered C-terminal polybasic motif consisting of eight lysines/arginines to phospholipids. Here we present extensive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the polybasic motif interacting with a model membrane composed of phosphatidylcholin (POPC) and phosphatidic acid (PA) and cell culture experiments. Protein-membrane binding effects are due to the electrostatic interactions between the polybasic amino acids and PAs. For significant binding the first three lysines turn out to be dispensable, which was also recapitulated in cell culture using transfected GFP-LKB1 variants. LKB1-membrane binding results in a non-monotonous changes in the structure of the protein as well as of the membrane, in particular accumulation of PAs and reduced thickness at the protein-membrane contact area. The protein-lipid binding turns out to be highly dynamic due to an interplay of PA-PA repulsion and protein-PA attraction. The thermodynamics of this interplay is captured by a statistical fluctuation model, which allows the estimation of both energies. Quantification of the significance of each polar amino acid in the polybasic provides detailed insights into the molecular mechanism of the protein-membrane binding of LKB1. These results can be likely transferred to other proteins, which interact by intrinsically disordered polybasic regions with anionic membranes.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质的固有无序区域负责许多生物过程，例如肝激酶LKB1——一种丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，与细胞增殖和细胞极性相关。LKB1本身通过其由八个赖氨酸/精氨酸组成的无序C端多碱基基序与磷脂结合，在招募至质膜后完全激活。在此，我们展示了多碱基基序与由磷脂酰胆碱（POPC）和磷脂酸（PA）组成的模型膜相互作用的广泛分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，以及细胞培养实验。蛋白质-膜结合效应源于多碱基氨基酸与PA之间的静电相互作用。对于显著结合，前三个赖氨酸被证明是非必需的，这一点在使用转染的GFP-LKB1变体的细胞培养中也得到了重现。LKB1-膜结合导致蛋白质及膜结构发生非单调变化，特别是在蛋白质-膜接触区域PA的积累和膜厚度的减少。蛋白质-脂质结合因PA-PA排斥与蛋白质-PA吸引的相互作用而显得高度动态。这种相互作用的熱力学通过统计涨落模型捕捉，该模型允许估算两种能量。对多碱基中每个极性氨基酸重要性的量化，为LKB1蛋白质-膜结合的分子机制提供了详细见解。这些结果可能适用于其他通过固有无序多碱基区域与阴离子膜相互作用的蛋白质。
